notes: Scenario 2.17 on Hermes is the trailing-'?' TEXT path, not a structured ask-user tool (hermes has none — see the assessment). One prompt asks for exactly one short clarifying question; the assistant row lands with finish_reason='stop' and question-ending content, Parser.ParseLine sets PendingWaitingCue via session.ProseIndicatesWaiting on the untruncated 400-rune window, and classifyAgentDone routes turn-done → waiting instead of → ready. The recipe deliberately STOPS at the waiting episode and never answers, so the asserted arc is ready → working → waiting with no fall-back to ready. Anchoring follows the hermes column's ProcessOwnedStore shape: the sessions row is INSERTed only on the first user message, so the ready birth in a recording is the transient proc-<PID> pre-session — session_birth is anchored to recording start and left UNPINNED, and turn_end_waiting chains off turn_start via same_session_as so it cannot match on the pre-session row. Hermes writes no transcript file; every signal here comes from $HERMES_HOME/state.db. tokens_nonzero reads the recording's metric vector (sessions.input_tokens+output_tokens); model and cost are deliberately unpinned because the recorded model depends on the run's HERMES_HOME config.yaml — record fills observations.model and may add cost_nonzero once the recorded model is known to be priced. UPDATE (record, 2026-08-02): observations.tokens_nonzero REMOVED and `model` pinned in its place from the real golden, doing what this note's last sentence asked. tokens_nonzero could never pass on this column, and the note above is wrong that it "reads the recording's metric vector (sessions.input_tokens+output_tokens)": `of verify` hard-asserts only against the newest recording's replay-golden `summary`, which the offline replay tool builds by driving core/pkg/tailer with hermes.Parser — and that Parser sets ONLY ev.ModelName. The sessions-row token vector reaches irrlicht solely through ComputeMetrics, a path replay never runs, and the store-derived token lift in tools/onboarding-factory/cmd/replay/metrics.go is gated to antigravity. This recording's golden shows exactly that: model_name=gpt-5.6-luna and no token or cost figure. cost_nonzero was correctly never added here for the same reason. A prior run on this column saw the pins red directly (✗ cost_usd: want >0 got 0, ✗ tokens: want >0 got 0) with all state phases green.

text: A hermes session appears in ready shortly after launch (expected to be the transient proc-<PID> pre-session — the store row does not exist until the first user message)
A PID is bound to the session (Hermes is a Python console script, matched on the full command line)
The user prompt drives the store-backed session ready → working
The assistant's question-ending reply (finish_reason='stop') classifies the SAME session working → waiting, and it stays there — the recipe never answers, so no later transition to ready may appear
